column1: # *** 11 OCTOBER 2026 - THE SWEEP WAS FINISHED, AND THE MARRIAGES WERE WHERE THE ANSWER WAS. ***
# The September pass took the first page and recorded the CHILDREN. Pages two to four carry the
# *** MARRIAGES ***, and they turn a diagram this archive has had for weeks into a sequence of events.
# *** THE 1911 DISPENSATION IS EXPLAINED BY THREE WEDDINGS IN THIRTEEN MONTHS. ***
#   22 March 1888  - BERNABE LERENA (b. c.1863, son of Bernabe and Casimira Pelaez) x FLORINDA CARDOZO
#   25 April 1889  - MARIA LERENA (b. c.1867, his sister) x ELISEO CARDOSO
#   25 April 1889  - CASIMIRA LERENA (b. c.1869, his sister) x JUAN BASILIO CARDOSO   *** THE SAME DAY ***
# A Lerena brother and his two Lerena sisters married a Cardozo sister and her two Cardozo brothers.
# *** THAT IS HOW YOU MANUFACTURE DOUBLE FIRST COUSINS ***, and in 1911 CUSTODIO LERENA - Bernabe and
# Florinda's son - had to be dispensed to marry EMA CARDOZO. *** THE MARRIAGE ITSELF IS NOW FOUND:
# 18 SEPTEMBER 1911 at Santisima Trinidad ***, so the dispensation was granted, which this archive had
# previously inferred from the birth of their daughter four years later.
#   *** WHAT IS STILL NOT SHOWN: WHICH CARDOZO FATHERED EMA. *** If it is Eliseo or Juan Basilio, the
#   doubling is accounted for exactly. The index does not say and no act has been opened.
# *** AND A DOUBLE WEDDING IS NOT A COINCIDENCE - IT IS A DECISION. *** Two sisters married two
# brothers on one day in one church. Whatever that says about land, dowry or convenience, it is the
# kind of event that makes a parish's blood run back on itself within two generations.

*** The double wedding. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 25 APRIL 1889 ***, two marriages. Index arks 1:1:XS6N-5CV6 and 1:1:XS6N-5CVL.
column2: *** MARIA LERENA ***, b. c.1867, and *** CASIMIRA LERENA ***, b. c.1869, both 'hijas de BERNABE LERENA y CASIMIRA PELAEZ', married *** ELISEO CARDOSO *** and *** JUAN BASILIO CARDOSO ***.
column3: *** THE SECOND SISTER IS NEW TO THIS ARCHIVE *** and so is the fact that the two weddings were one event. Together with the 1888 marriage it supplies *** BOTH BLOOD PATHS *** the 1911 expediente calls a double impediment.

column1: *** Bernabe the younger's marriage. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 22 MARCH 1888 ***.
column2: *** BERNABE LERENA ***, b. c.1863, son of Bernabe Lerena and Casimira Pelaez, married *** FLORINDA CARDOSO ***.
column3: Dates a marriage this archive held only as a pairing, and confirms his parents from a second record. *** HE IS THE FATHER OF CUSTODIO. ***

column1: *** Custodio and Ema. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 18 SEPTEMBER 1911 ***.
column2: *** CUSTODIO LERENA ***, b. c.1889, son of *** BERNABE LERENA and FLORINDA CARDOZO ***, married *** EMA [CARDOZO] ***.
column3: *** THE DISPENSATION WAS GRANTED, AND NOW IT IS THE ACT THAT SAYS SO *** rather than an inference from their daughter's birth in 1915.

column1: *** Socorro's marriage. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** 15 JULY 1885 ***. Index ark 1:1:XS6J-975Z.
column2: *** SOCORRO LERENA ***, b. c.1855, married *** SERAPIO FERNANDEZ ***.
column3: Dates a marriage this register had only as a relationship, and puts a *** second Lerena wedding at Trinidad in 1885 *** beside the dispensation already held for that year.

column1: *** Aurora's parents. *** Civil registrations of her children at Trinidad, 1891-1904. Index ark 1:1:XS6J-GBZQ.
column2: *** AURORA LERENA ***, b. c.1868, 'hija de *** ALEJANDRO F. LERENA *** y *** NATALIA LERENA ***', wife of *** MANUEL VAQUERO ***, at least five children.
column3: *** A FOURTH LERENA-MARRIED-A-LERENA COUPLE *** - and it names ALEJANDRO F. LERENA, one of the two men work-list row 137 calls unworked, giving him a wife and a daughter for the first time.

column1: *** A child of the Rosario house at Trinidad. *** Santisima Trinidad, *** April 1882 ***.
column2: *** MANUEL LERENA ***, b. c.1856, 'hijo de *** MAURICIO LERENA *** y *** CASIMIRA MONTANA ***', married *** JACINTA MARINA ***.
column3: *** A SECOND, INDEPENDENT THREAD FROM COLLA-ROSARIO TO TRINIDAD ***, alongside the bridge in data/colla-trinidad-bridge.tsv. Mauricio and Casimira married at Colla in 1837; their son was marrying in Flores by 1882.
